business_problem: Haidian needed to replace labor-intensive, department-by-department city management with a coordinated system that could combine huge amounts of sensor, camera and departmental data into faster operational decisions.
solution_summary: Haidian District and Baidu AI Cloud built a 'city brain' that treats urban management as a cross-department data and AI problem rather than a set of isolated manual processes. The architecture follows a 1+1+2+N model: one sensing network, one smart-cloud platform, two shared centers for data and AI computation, and many application scenarios. In production it integrates field cameras, sensors, worksite records, road and satellite data plus city and district data from multiple departments into a single governance fabric. AI recognition, spatiotemporal analysis and knowledge-graph techniques then drive end-to-end monitoring, prediction, dispatch and non-contact enforcement. The most detailed example is dump-truck governance, where source sites, routes, violations and disposal points are stitched into one chain so the system can identify events, predict trajectories and push precise evidence to transportation and city-management teams. The same operating layer also powers bike parking, complaint dispatch, sanitation and weather-response scenarios.

solution_components.name: Smart City
solution_components.role: Provides the overall city-brain operating framework for Haidian's governance scenarios.

solution_components.name: Data Middle Platform
solution_components.role: Unifies multi-department urban data into one shared service center.

solution_components.name: AI Computing Center
solution_components.role: Runs recognition and prediction algorithms across city-management use cases.

solution_components.name: Spatiotemporal Data Platform
solution_components.role: Connects maps, sensors and route data for event analysis and operational dispatch.

data_flow: Video, sensor, worksite and departmental data are ingested into the data platform and AI center, where recognition and prediction models generate alerts and dispatch signals that are pushed back to city-management, transport, sanitation and complaint-handling teams.
business_outcome: Haidian reduced manual coordination, improved urban-enforcement precision and created a reusable city-governance platform that now supports many municipal scenarios beyond the initial dump-truck use case.
metrics: Recognition accuracy for obscured license plates reached above 95%.
Dump-truck violation rates dropped from 26% to 4%.
The platform integrates nearly 50 billion urban-sensing records and adds more than 60 million new records per day.
architecture_clues: The city brain follows a 1+1+2+N architecture
The platform integrates more than 10,000 cameras and about 20,000 sensor points
AI is used for non-contact enforcement and dispatch across multiple departments
evidence_quotes: Haidian adopted a 'city brain' to solve city-management pain points across management, traffic, environment and public safety (original: 双方将利用云计算、大数据、人工智能等新技术，在城市管理、交通治理、环境保护、公共安全等领域率先应用“城市大脑”).
Dump-truck governance improved sharply, with obscured-plate recognition above 95% and violations falling from 26% to 4% (original: 系统对渣土车号牌遮挡等违法特征识别的准确率达到95%以上……渣土车违规率从26%下降到了4%).

The platform already connects more than 10,000 cameras, around 20,000 sensors and nearly 50 billion records, adding over 60 million new records a day (original: 目前，海淀城市大脑已接入全区1万多路摄像头、2万左右传感器监测点位……汇聚多维度的城市感知数据近50亿条，每天新增数据量超6千万条).
